# Synthetic FLAC regression fixture

`tone-22050.flac` is an original synthetic 440 Hz sine wave generated for this
repository. It has no third-party recording content and is distributed under
the repository's MIT license. It contains 4410 mono 16-bit frames at 22050 Hz.

Independent fixture encoder: FFmpeg 6.1.1-3ubuntu5, using this command:

```sh
ffmpeg -v error -f lavfi -i 'sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=22050:duration=0.2' \
  -c:a flac -sample_fmt s16 -map_metadata -1 -fflags +bitexact \
  -flags:a +bitexact -n tests/fixtures/tone-22050.flac
```

SHA-256: `51c29546c42a0503b3bf983d57fed12bc7bd35b395f097ad155a0af43c858b34`.
FFprobe independently reports the rate, mono channel, 4410-frame duration and
16-bit depth. FFmpeg is used only to author this checked-in fixture; running
the Rust converter or the tests does not require it.
